name: Butyl 3-mercaptopropionate
description: Butyl 3-mercaptopropionate (CAS 16215-21-7 ) is a thiol-functional ester used as a reactive building block and performance additive across polymer chemistry and industrial lubrication. Its free thiol group enables participation in sulfur-based reaction mechanisms that underpin both polymerization processes and boundary lubrication performance in various industrial settings. In polymer systems, it functions as a chain transfer agent and crosslinking co-monomer, allowing formulators to control molecular weight distribution and introduce thiol-ene reactive sites. Lubricant formulators incorporate it into metalworking fluids and gear oils where sulfur-containing additives reduce friction and protect metal surfaces under extreme pressure conditions. It also serves as a reactive intermediate in synthesizing polythiol crosslinkers, which are used to produce fast-curing coatings and sealants with controlled network density. Plastics compounders may use it as a processing stabilizer or co-agent in systems where thiol reactivity improves compatibility between polymer phases during the manufacturing process. Butyl 3-mercaptopropionate is supplied as a liquid at standard commercial purity levels, typically 95% or higher. It is available in technical grade for industrial and polymer applications. Packaging ranges from small laboratory quantities to drum-scale supply for industrial buyers, ensuring flexible procurement options for diverse manufacturing requirements and scales.
